Version.description: API version requested by the consumer, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH (SOL 013 9.4); any version with the served major version is accepted.
Version.name: Version

ApiVersionInformation.description: API versions served under a URI prefix (SOL 013 9.3.3).

version.description: Version served, with the implementation suffix, e.g. 1.0.0-impl:kubenfv.io:kube-vim:0.4.0.

uriPrefix.description: URI prefix of the API, e.g. /compute/v1.

type.description: https://kubevim.kubenfv.io/problems/<reason>, the error reason (ErrorReason in the protos) in kebab case, e.g. .../problems/resource-in-use; about:blank for authentication and authorisation errors. Clients should accept unknown types.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.CpuArchitectur.description:
CPU architecture.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.OperationalSta.description: Operational state of a virtualised resource (IFA006).

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.SnapshotStatus.description:
Status of a snapshot.
Values may be added as snapshot support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.TypeOfStorage.description:
Type of a virtualised storage resource.
Values may be added as Kubernetes storage support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.VirtualCpuPinn.description:
CPU pinning policy (IFA006 8.4.2.4). IFA's STATIC policy with explicit rules is left out:
KubeVirt places dedicated CPUs itself.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.VirtualStorage.description: Size, type and capabilities of a virtualised storage resource.

isBoot.description: The software image is copied to this storage and the compute resource boots from it.

sizeOfStorage.description: Size of the storage resource, in Kubernetes quantity format (e.g. "20Gi").

storageClass.description: Kubernetes storage class of the storage, one labelled kubevim.kubenfv.io/storage=true; the VIM default when unset.

kubenfv.kubevim.common.v1.Volume.description: A virtualised storage resource, e.g. a disk of a compute resource.

computeId.description: Compute resource that uses the volume; empty when not attached.

hostId.description: Host of the volume; empty for distributed storage.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

storageData.description: Size, type and capabilities of the volume.

volumeId.description:
Identifier of the volume: a UUID assigned by the VIM for volumes created with the storage API.
The own disks of a compute resource (its boot disk and the disks from its flavour) are not
resources of their own and use their disk name instead.

volumeName.description: Name of the volume, given by the consumer; not unique.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.Compute.description: A virtualised compute resource: a virtual machine.

computeId.description: Identifier of the compute resource: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

computeName.description: Name of the compute resource, given by the consumer; not unique.

disks.description:
Disks of the compute resource: its own disks (the boot disk and the disks from the flavour,
identified by disk name, deleted with the compute resource and not in the storage API) and
attached volumes (identified by their volume_id).

flavourId.description: Flavour the compute resource is sized by; it needs exactly one boot storage attribute.

hostId.description: Host the compute resource runs on (the Kubernetes node).

imageId.description: Software image the compute resource boots from.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

networkInterfaces.description:
Network interfaces, the management interface first; no other order is guaranteed, in the response
or in the guest. Match interfaces by name, MAC address or guest PCI address.

operationalState.description: Operational state of the compute resource.

placementGroupIds.description: Placement groups the compute resource belongs to, joined at creation.

restartRequired.description: A change (a flavour beyond the hotplug limits, or interfaces of a VM that cannot live-migrate) applies on the next restart.

runningState.description: Running state of the compute resource.

statusDetail.description: Human-readable reason when the running state is FAILED.

virtualCpu.description: Virtual CPUs of the compute resource.

virtualMemory.description: Virtual memory of the compute resource.

zoneId.description: Resource zone of the compute resource.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.ComputeOperat.description:
Operation on the running state of a compute resource (IFA006 7.3.1.6).
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.ComputeRunnin.description:
Running state of a compute resource.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.ComputeSnapsh.description: A snapshot of a compute resource (KubeVirt VirtualMachineSnapshot).

computeId.description:
Compute resource the snapshot was taken of. The snapshot is kept when the compute resource is
deleted; the VIM then sets the metadata key "kubevim.kubenfv.io/source-deleted" to "true".

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

snapshotId.description: Identifier of the snapshot: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

snapshotName.description: Name of the snapshot, given by the consumer; not unique.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.ComputeUpdate.description:
Changes to a compute resource: a patch. The name is replaced when set, metadata entries are
merged, and interfaces are added (hotplug) or removed by name.

metadata.description: Metadata entries to add, or to overwrite when the key exists; keys not given are kept, and none is removed.

networkInterfaceNamesToRemove.description: Names of network interfaces to remove.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.IpAssignment.description: How a network interface gets its addresses.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.NetworkInterf.description: A network interface requested for a compute resource.

bandwidth.description: Rate limit in Mbps; 0 means no limit.

ipAddresses.description: Addresses for the static assignment: at most one per IP version; a family left out is allocated automatically.

ipAssignment.description: How the interface gets its addresses; automatic when unset.

macAddress.description: MAC address; the VIM assigns one when unset.

model.description: NIC model the guest sees; virtio when unset.

name.description: Name of the interface, unique within the compute resource; the VIM chooses one when unset.

networkId.description: Network to attach to; the interface gets one address per subnet of the network.

typeVirtualNic.description: How the interface is realised; the VIM chooses from the network when unset.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.NicModel.description:
NIC model the guest sees.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.PlacementEnfo.description: Whether a placement policy must hold.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.PlacementGrou.description: A group of compute resources placed together or apart (decision 0005).

enforcement.description: Whether the policy must hold or is applied when possible; PLACEMENT_ENFORCEMENT_REQUIRED when unset.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

placementGroupId.description: Identifier of the group: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

placementGroupName.description: Name of the group, given by the consumer; not unique.

scope.description: Topology domain the policy applies to; PLACEMENT_SCOPE_NODE when unset.

type.description: Whether members are placed together or apart.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.PlacementScop.description:
Topology domain a placement policy applies to.
Values may be added; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.PlacementType.description: Whether members of a placement group are placed together or apart.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.TypeVirtualNi.description:
How a network interface is realised.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.UserData.description: User data passed to the compute resource at boot time.

content.description: User data, e.g. a cloud-init document; transparent to the VIM.

method.description: How the content reaches the guest; NoCloud when unset.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.UserDataTrans.description:
How user data reaches the guest.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualCpu.description: Virtual CPUs of a compute resource.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualCpuPin.description: CPU pinning of a compute resource.

cpuMap.description: Physical CPU each virtual CPU is pinned to; empty when the VIM cannot tell.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualMemory.description: Virtual memory of a compute resource.

hugepageSize.description: Hugepage size backing the memory; empty for regular pages.

virtualMemSize.description: Amount of memory, in Kubernetes quantity format.

kubenfv.kubevim.compute.v1.VirtualNetwor.description: A network interface of a compute resource.

bandwidth.description: Rate limit in Mbps; 0 when not limited.

computeId.description: Compute resource the interface belongs to.

guestInterfaceName.description: Interface name in the guest, e.g. "eth1"; empty when the guest agent does not report it.

guestPciAddress.description: PCI address of the device in the guest; empty until known.

hostPciAddress.description: PCI address of the device on the host, for SR-IOV interfaces.

ipAddresses.description: Addresses of the interface, one per subnet of its network; may be empty until DHCP or the guest configures them.

isManagement.description: The management interface every compute resource gets on the pod network.

name.description: Name of the interface, unique within the compute resource: the one given at creation, or one the VIM chose.

networkId.description: Network the interface is attached to; empty for the management interface.

operationalState.description: ENABLED once the interface is attached and ready.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials (SOL 013 8.3). The token URL is deployment specific.
